Title: ENERMAX Introduces REVOLUTION D.F. X ATX 3.0 Power Supply Series from 850W to 1600W - Community - ENERMAX Technology Corporation
URL: https://www.enermax.com/en/news/enermax-introduces-revolution-d.f.-x-atx-3.0-power-supply-series-from-850w-to-1650w
Published: 2023-06-30T00:00:00.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
### ENERMAX Introduces REVOLUTION D.F. X ATX 3.0 Power Supply Series from 850W to 1650W

Taoyuan, Taiwan, June 30th 2023- ENERMAX, an industry-leading force dedicated to designing extreme performance computer power supplies and cooling solutions, launches its latest Intel ATX 3.0 and PCIe 5.0 ready power supply series –the REVOLUTION D.F. X, from 850W to 1650W, featuring one native 600W 12VHPWR cable, an extra 600W 12VHPWR adaptor cable for multiple GPUs usage, ARGB side panel and ENERMAX’s patented Dust-free Rotation technology for self-cleaning function to make sure your systems run stable and stylish for years.

The REVOLUTION D.F. X power supply series is 80 PLUS Gold certified and compliant with Intel ATX 3.0 and PCIe 5.0 standards in a compact 140mm chassis in depth. To meet the demands of ultra-efficiency computing performance, REVOLUTION D.F. X is characterized by industrial-grade 100% Japanese capacitors, advanced LLC and Synchronous Rectifier (SR) design to deliver outstanding performance and unparalleled flexibility for PC enthusiasts and professionals.

The ENERMAX’s patented Dust-free Rotation technology enables the fan inside to blow away dust upon powering on, keeps the power supply remains clean, prevents any future disruption and ensures a stable power delivery for years.

Moreover, the fan is designed with ENERMAX semi-fanless technology, it allows the fan to be completely off until the load exceeds 20% to create 0 dB(A) environment and ensures a quiet operation during minimum load. The fan is designed with a 6-pole, 3-phase motor and pressure blades to deliver extremely high air pressure and high airflow while maintaining outstanding quietness. 

The REVOLUTION D.F. X series also comes with an ARGB side panel with built-in 14 RGB lighting modes. It allows gamers to light up their REVOLUTION D.F. X without additional software installation required. The RGB control button next to the power switch allows customers to turn it off at night with one push. Customers can also sync the lighting effects of REVOLUTION D.F. X via the supported motherboard’s software.

The REVOLUTION D.F. X 850W, 1050W and 1200W are now available from ENERMAX’s worldwide authorized retailers and distributors; the 1350W and 1650W will be released in late Q3 this year. ENERMAX offers up to 10 years warranty for the REVOLUTION D.F. X series; the warranty term may be different by region. For more information, please visit ENERMAX’s website.

---
